title: Lead Business Analyst
description:

**Lead Business Analyst**

* Ability to execute with speed and efficiency while maintaining high-quality outputs.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and business judgment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work closely with senior business and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership and ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

* Experience working closely with product, sales, marketing, operations, or growth teams.

* Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, data pipelines, and event tracking.
* Experience implementing ML-driven business solutions or working with data science teams.
* Prior experience mentoring analysts or leading analytics projects.

* Has strong business acumen and understands how numbers translate into business performance.

description:
**Introduction**
**Retail Media Data Operations Analyst:**
The Retail Media Data Operations Analyst is responsible for transforming fragmented reporting from retail media networks, third-party media partners, retailers, and measurement providers into standardized, validated, analysis-ready datasets.
  
  
This role serves as the operational bridge between media activation, partner reporting, Business Intelligence, and client analytics. The analyst will manage the data preparation lifecycle from reporting intake and completeness checks through normalization, quality assurance, documentation, and delivery so the media teams can dedicate more time to performance analysis, strategic recommendations, and executive storytelling.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Reporting Intake and Operational Management
  
  

* Maintain a centralized inventory of required campaign, retailer, media partner, and measurement reporting.
* Track expected reporting dates, delivery status, missing inputs, and data-processing progress.
* Download or collect reporting from partner portals, shared locations, email deliveries, APIs, and other approved sources.
* Organize source files using established folder structures, file-naming standards, version controls, and retention requirements.
* Maintain reporting calendars and communicate potential delays before they affect recap and wrap-report timelines.

Data Preparation and Standardization
  
  

* Consolidate partner reports delivered through spreadsheets, flat files, PDFs, presentations, and self-service reporting platforms.
* Transform source data into standardized reporting templates and analysis-ready datasets.
* Normalize campaign, retailer, brand, product, audience, placement, creative, tactic, and business-unit naming conventions.
* Map partner-specific metrics to approved enterprise metric definitions.
* Reconcile retailer, product, UPC, campaign, placement, and organizational hierarchies.
* Document transformations, assumptions, exclusions, and calculations so outputs can be consistently reproduced.

Data Quality and Validation
  
  

* Perform completeness, accuracy, reasonableness, duplication, and reconciliation checks before datasets are released for analysis.
* Validate reported spend, impressions, clicks, sales, units, ROAS, audience results, and other applicable metrics against source totals and campaign plans.
* Identify anomalies, missing reporting dimensions, inconsistent metric definitions, and unsupported comparisons.
* Maintain a data-quality and exception log that documents issues, owners, status, resolution, and downstream impact.
* Escalate material data-quality risks to BI and Retail Media leadership.
* Ensure that corrected or restated partner data is versioned and reflected in downstream datasets.

Automation Readiness
  
  

* Develop reusable templates, mapping tables, validation routines, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify recurring manual activities that are candidates for automation.
* Translate operational processes into documented requirements for BI, data engineering, and Catalyst development.
* Partner with BI to test automated ingestion, transformation, validation, and exceptionmanagement workflows.
* Help establish standardized data contracts and reporting specifications for priority partners.
* Support the transition from manually prepared files to scalable, governed data pipelines without disrupting current client deliverables.

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Business Intelligence on data structures, architecture, governance, and quality standards.
* Partner with Retail Media and Shopper Marketing teams on campaign objectives, tactics, partner requirements, and reporting interpretation.
* Work with Retail Media teams to ensure datasets meet downstream analysis and storytelling requirements.
* Participate in partner onboarding and reporting-requirement discussions when needed.

Communicate status, risks, missing inputs, and dependencies clearly to stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s degree in analytics, business, marketing, information systems, data management, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Two or more years of experience in reporting operations, marketing analytics, retail media, shopper marketing, digital media, or data operations.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivots, lookups, data cleansing, reconciliation, and structured data preparation.
* Experience consolidating data from multiple sources with inconsistent formats and definitions.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information.
* Ability to document processes, mappings, business rules, and data-quality issues clearly.
* Strong written communication and the ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders and time zones.
* Ability to manage recurring deliverables, changing priorities, and firm client deadlines.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with retail media networks, shopper marketing programs, or CPG campaign measurement.
* Familiarity with reporting from retailers, RMNs, and partners such as ADUSA, Inmar, Neptune, or Chicory.
* Understanding of media and commerce metrics such as impressions, clicks, engagement, spend, attributed sales, ROAS, incrementality, household penetration, and product-level performance.
* Experience with Power Query, SQL, Power BI, data-preparation tools, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with campaign taxonomies, product hierarchies, UPC mapping, retailer hierarchies, and metric governance.
* Experience documenting requirements for automated ingestion or data-platform development.

title: Capacity Management Analyst (Immediate joiners preferred)
description:
**Description**
Our team is recruiting! What are we looking for?
  
  
The Workforce Strategy & Operations team manages the end-to-end workforce life cycle, globally, for services engagements. Capacity Planning is a dedicated function within the team. It is responsible for demand and supply forecasting, bench visibility and data-driven decision support for hiring and staffing strategy.
  
  
The Capacity Analyst is a hands-on data and modelling role. It supports capacity forecasting for our Global Delivery Center & APAC businesses.
  
  
This is not a role for reporting what the system already shows. We need someone who can take raw, messy data, clean it, model it and forecast beyond what is available in the system. They add their own analysis and intelligence, and turn the result into clear visuals that leaders can act on.
  
  
Key areas of responsibility include: Data Preparation & Integrity, Forecasting & Modelling, Visualization & Insight, Scope & Collaboration.
  
  
We are looking for someone with 3+ years of experience in capacity planning, workforce planning, data analytics or a similar analytical role. You should have proven data mining, statistical modelling and visualisation skills.
  
  
You should Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-native delivery, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g. Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude).
  
  
**Data Preparation & Integrity**

* Source, mine and combine data from multiple systems and offline sources, going beyond what is available in the system of record
* Clean, validate and reconcile large, messy datasets into a trusted, decision-ready source
* Correct known data issues (e.g. unrealistic demand swings) before they reach stakeholders
* Document data logic, assumptions and definitions so outputs are repeatable and auditable

**Forecasting & Modeling**

* Build and maintain demand and supply forecasts across a rolling horizon of two high-likelihood quarters plus a third best-case quarter. This gives leadership enough runway for hiring decisions
* Develop statistical and predictive models, including scenario and sensitivity analysis, rather than only relying on system-reported numbers
* Model demand and supply at the role and cloud-practice level, so business leaders can self-serve more granular slices of the data
* Flag growth areas where in-house hiring or cross-skilling is the right call, rather than defaulting to subcontractor backfill
* Track forecast accuracy against actuals and continuously refine the models

**Visualization & Insight**

* Own and evolve self-service dashboards (e.g. in Tableau)
* Maintain the supply & demand dashboard tracking demand change by role and skill
* Turn analysis into clear, visual data stories that show supply, demand and skills-profile challenges for leadership
* Add intelligence on top of the data: highlight drivers, risks and recommended actions, not just number

**Minimum Requirements**

* Strong analytics background with proven data mining, statistical and data modelling skills
* Hands-on experience building forecasting models, not only consuming system reports
* Hands-on experience with Tableau or a similar BI tool, including building dashboards end to end
* Ability to interpret large, messy datasets and deliver clean, trustworthy data
* Ability to present analysis visually and clearly

**Must-Have Skills**

* Capacity planning and forecasting modeling
* Data mining, cleansing and analytics
* Tableau (or equivalent BI tool such as Power BI)
* Dashboard design and maintenance
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* SQL and/or Python (or R) for data prep and modeling
* AI-assisted analysis (e.g. Claude, Agentforce, ChatGPT, Gemini) for faster analysis, modeling and insight generation

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Workforce or resource management background
* CRM Analytics / Tableau Next
* Exposure to Org62 / FinancialForce (Certinia) or similar PSA tools
* Experience automating data pipelines and refreshes

title: Mechanical Design Enginee
description:
**Company Description**
Altem Technologies Pvt Ltd is a leading Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Software Value Solutions Platinum Partner for Dassault Systèmes and a key distributor of Stratasys 3D printers in India since 2010. The company focuses on creating a positive, engaging workplace where passionate, agile teams deliver innovative solutions and outstanding customer experiences. Altem partners with hundreds of Indian and global organizations across sectors such as automotive, aerospace, defence, medical, consumer durables, electronics, architecture, and academia to accelerate innovation and productivity. By offering a comprehensive portfolio including CATIA, DELMIA, 3DVIA, ENOVIA, Stratasys FDM and PolyJet 3D printers, Artec 3D scanners, MSC CAE, and ESTECO optimization solutions, Altem delivers complete 3D experience solutions. Headquartered in Bangalore, Altem operates through sales offices in Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and New Delhi, providing nationwide support and opportunities for career growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Tooling & EOAT Development: Design custom robotic End-of-Arm Tooling (EOAT), including mechanical grippers, vacuum manifold systems, pneumatic tools, and application-specific attachments.

Workholding & Fixtures: Design robust cell fixtures, assembly jigs, and inspection gauges with accurate datum structures and locating mechanisms.

CAD & Detailed Analysis: Create 3D models, assemblies, and detailed manufacturing drawings adhering to ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards. Perform tolerance stack-up, structural strength, and mass property analyses to ensure designs remain within robot payload and inertia limits.

Pneumatics & Actuation: Size and select pneumatic components (cylinders, solenoid valves, FRL units, vacuum generators, and suction cups) using vendor catalog tools from SMC, Festo, Schmalz, or Piab. Sensors & Wiring: Integrate inductive proximity sensors, vacuum switches, and discrete or IO-Link junction blocks, ensuring proper cabling and dress-pack routing.

RFQ & Cost Estimation: Review customer specifications and part drawings, translate requirements into technical specifications, and generate conceptual designs, preliminary Bills of Materials (BOMs), and cycle-time estimates for proposals.

DFM/DFA & Vendor Follow-ups: Optimize components for CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, and 3D printing. Actively manage vendor follow-ups, component sourcing, lead times, and technical clarifications with machine shops.

Installation & Commissioning: Install, align, test, and troubleshoot EOAT and fixtures inside robot cells or at customer facilities.

**Qualifications**

* Education Baseline: B.E., B.Tech, or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* Hands-On Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in mechanical design and manufacturing, taking parts from CAD concepts through to physical fabrication and assembly.
* Project Ownership: Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of mechanical deliverables—taking complete accountability for assigned tooling and fixture modules from concept through vendor fabrication to final cell integration.
* Vendor Sourcing & Follow-ups: Direct experience managing external supplier and machine shop follow-ups, tracking quotation lead times, evaluating fabrication capabilities, and resolving technical queries.
* CAD & Drawing Standards: Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, Fusion 360, or equivalent) with a solid understanding of ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards and tolerance stack-up analysis.
* Manufacturing Knowledge: Practical application of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) across CNC machining, sheet metal bending, welding, and 3D printing.
* Pneumatics & Component Sizing: Direct experience selecting and sizing pneumatic actuators, vacuum systems, and basic electrical sensors from industrial vendor catalogs.
* Field Execution & Mobility: Hands-on experience installing, tuning, and troubleshooting mechanical systems on the shop floor or customer sites. Willingness to travel for commissioning as needed.

title: GIS Analyst II (5-8 Years of exp with Python/ FME/ ArcGIS)
description:
**Overview**
Seeking an experienced GIS professional with strong capabilities in AGOL, ArcGIS Enterprise solutions, Python automation, and FME, with practical experience in delivering spatial analysis, data workflows, technical support, and GIS solutions across engineering projects.
  
  
Your role
  
  
*Geospatial Data Management*

* Create, edit, digitize, and maintain spatial datasets, including feature classes, enterprise and file geodatabases, domains, subtypes, and relationship classes.
* Manage multiple evolving datasets while maintaining data integrity, consistency, traceability, and metadata completeness.
* Develop and maintain structured data models in accordance with project and client requirements.
* Perform data cleansing, transformation, migration, and validation across multiple formats and systems.
* Apply appropriate coordinate reference systems, transformations, and georeferencing methods.
* Maintain clear documentation for data sources, processing steps, assumptions, and limitations.

*Spatial Analysis and GIS Deliverables*

* Undertake spatial analysis using vector, raster, network, and 3D datasets.
* Perform overlay, proximity, buffering, suitability, terrain, visibility, and network analyses, as applicable to project requirements.
* Develop geoprocessing workflows and analytical models to support informed project decision-making.
* Interpret geospatial results and communicate findings through maps, dashboards, reports, and technical documentation.
* Deliver outputs in accordance with agreed project scope, quality standards, program, and client expectations.

*Esri Software and ArcGIS Pro*

* Use ArcGIS Pro for spatial data editing, analysis, geoprocessing, modeling, cartographic production, and publishing.
* Apply relevant Esri extensions, including:

+ Spatial Analyst for raster analysis, suitability modeling, and map algebra.
+ 3D Analyst for terrain, TIN, DTM, DSM, visibility, and 3D-scene workflows.
+ Network Analyst for routing, closest-facility, and service-area analysis.
+ Data Interoperability for data conversion and integration workflows.

* Develop and maintain ModelBuilder and Python-based geoprocessing tools.
* Troubleshoot ArcGIS Pro projects, geoprocessing tools, datasets, and publishing workflows.
* Apply appropriate naming conventions, folder structures, metadata, and version-control practices.

*ArcGIS Online and Web GIS*

* Create, configure, and maintain content in ArcGIS Online, including hosted feature layers, web maps, dashboards, and web applications.
* Publish and manage geospatial services while applying appropriate sharing, access, and security settings.
* Configure and support applications using ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, Survey123, and Field Maps.
* Develop and maintain field-data collection workflows, including forms, validation rules, symbology, and offline configurations.
* Monitor hosted content, dependencies, data updates, permissions, and credit usage.
* Support users with web GIS applications, mobile workflows, and content-management requirements.

*ArcGIS Enterprise*

* Work with ArcGIS Enterprise, including ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Server, and enterprise geodatabases.
* Publish and manage feature, map, image, and geoprocessing services.
* Support user access, roles, groups, sharing controls, and content governance.
* Assist with enterprise GIS data maintenance, service updates, issue resolution, and workflow improvement.
* Work with database and system-administration teams to support reliable enterprise GIS environments.
* Understand multi-user editing, versioning, replication, and enterprise geodatabase concepts.

*FME and Data Integration*

* Design, develop, and maintain FME Workbench workflows for spatial data translation, transformation, validation, and integration.
* Automate repeatable data-processing and quality-control activities.
* Integrate GIS data with CAD, BIM, survey, database, spreadsheet, and web-service sources.
* Develop robust FME workflows with appropriate parameters, transformers, logging, error handling, and validation.
* Use FME Flow, where applicable, to publish, schedule, monitor, and manage automated workflows.
* Optimize existing FME processes to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability.
* Prepare clear technical documentation for FME workspaces and automated processes.

*Python and VBA Automation*

* Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts for spatial-data processing, geoprocessing, and workflow automation.
* Use Python, ArcPy, and ArcGIS API for Python to automate ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Enterprise workflows.
* Create reusable tools and scripts for data validation, map production, report generation, and service administration.
* Apply suitable coding practices, including modular development, exception handling, logging, documentation, and testing.
* Use VBA to automate Excel-based data processing, reporting, validation, and project-support workflows.
* Review and troubleshoot existing Python and VBA scripts.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through effective automation.

*CAD, Survey, and Engineering Data Integration*

* Integrate engineering and survey datasets into GIS workflows, including DWG, DXF, DGN, CSV, raster, point-cloud, and database formats.
* Validate coordinate systems, spatial alignment, geometry, scale, and units when integrating CAD and survey data.
* Transform CAD and survey data into structured GIS datasets with appropriate attribution.
* Understand survey data accuracy, tolerances, symbology, and representation requirements.
* Collaborate with CAD, BIM, engineering, and survey teams to resolve data-alignment and interoperability issues.

*Cartography and Map Production*

* Design and produce high-quality maps, layouts, map series, and digital cartographic products.
* Apply appropriate symbology, visual hierarchy, annotation, labeling, and scale-dependent display.
* Develop reusable map templates, layouts, and styles to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Ensure that deliverables comply with applicable client, project, and cartographic standards.
* Review maps for positional accuracy, completeness, clarity, and presentation quality.

*Quality Assurance and Quality Control*

* Conduct QA/QC reviews of spatial datasets, maps, applications, and automated workflows.
* Check topology, geometry, attribution, projection, completeness, positional accuracy, and metadata.
* Develop and maintain QA/QC checklists, validation rules, and supporting evidence.
* Identify data-quality issues, assess their impact, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Participate in peer reviews and ensure that deliverables comply with the agreed quality-management process.
* Promote continuous improvement and standardization across GIS delivery workflows.

*Project Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration*

* Support the planning and delivery of GIS work packages across multidisciplinary projects.
* Prepare methodologies, work instructions, technical notes, effort estimates, and progress updates.
* Manage assigned activities against agreed budgets, programs, and quality requirements.
* Communicate technical risks, assumptions, dependencies, and solutions clearly.
* Present geospatial information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal disciplines, regional teams, and client representatives.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members where required.

**About You**
*Essential Requirements*

* Bachelor'S or postgraduate qualification in GIS, Geospatial Science, Geography, Geomatics, Surveying, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant discipline.
* 5–8 years of relevant professional GIS experience, preferably within engineering, infrastructure, environmental, utilities, transport, or asset-management projects.
* Strong hands-on experience with:

+ ArcGIS Pro
+ ArcGIS Online
+ ArcGIS Enterprise

+ ArcGIS Experience Builder

*Individual Attributes*
**The Successful Candidate Should**

* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a quality-focused approach.
* Understand project-delivery processes, business priorities, risks, and quality requirements.

title: System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  
• Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
  
• Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
  
• Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
  
• IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
  
• Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
  
• Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
  
• DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
  
• Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
  
• Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

We believe you bring:
  
• 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
  
• Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
  
• Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
  
• Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
  
• Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
  
• IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
  
• DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  
• Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR
  
This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  
• Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
  
• Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
  
• Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
  
• Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
  
• Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
  
• Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
  
• IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
  
• DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).
  
  
Nice to have:
  
• Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
  
• Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
  
• Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
  
• Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
  
• Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
  
• BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.
  
  
Personal Competencies:
  
• Passion to write code and build solutions.
  
• Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
  
• Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
  
• Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
  
• Fluent in English, written and spoken.
  
  
Education and certifications:
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
  
• Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
  
• Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About The Team**
At Zillow, we understand that there’s nothing more powerful than home, providing physical and emotional security for today, and financial opportunity for tomorrow. But for many, finding and getting home is a challenge, marked by complexity at best, and real barriers at worst. So just as we gave customers the advantage of information that helped them to find home, today we’re giving them everything they need to get home. We believe that home should be more than just a dream and our purpose is to make home a reality for more and more people.
  
  
This has led our business to build solutions related to financing, buying, selling, and renting. Our work is also changing as we learn to collaborate in a cloud HQ environment, with team members spread across the nation. Together, we are all stewards of a promise we make to those we serve - a promise that is built on trust through every touchpoint people have with us. As a team, we are ensuring that every Zillow employee feels a sense of shared ownership of this promise, so they understand it, feel connected to it, and are equipped to live it every day.
  
  
In that light, Zillow's Brand Strategy & Insights (BS&I) team is kicking off a search for someone to help us better understand the perceptions of our customers and partners. Our team carries the brand measurement programs and research tooling the marketing organization uses to answer those questions with evidence, and to see whether the brand is gaining or losing ground over time.
  
  
As a Sr Insights Analyst, you will play a meaningful role in developing a truly iconic brand. This role reports to our Senior Manager, Insights
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Brand Measurement Analyst, you own the methodology, fielding, and analysis behind Zillow's brand measurement programs. You design and weight our longitudinal surveys, build the analyses that turns tracking data into a defensible read on brand health, and connect survey data to onsite behavioral data so the business can see which way a metric is heading and why.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own sampling plans, quotas, and weighting approaches across our longitudinal programs.
* Triangulate data with other sources to tell more complete stories.
* Write and maintain advanced questionnaires, including logic, branching, and bias checks, and make instrument changes that protect trend comparability.
* Build reproducible longitudinal analyses, and set the goal projections Marketing uses in annual planning.
* Build and maintain dashboards and AI-first automated reporting outputs so partners can answer their own questions without routing through us.
* Connect survey data to first-party behavioral data to explain why a metric moved.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5+ years in quantitative research, survey methodology, or marketing analytics.
* Expertise in survey design and methodology for repeated cross-sectional and longitudinal studies, including sampling, quotas, and weighting.
* Expertise in descriptive and inferential statistics, with proficiency in R or Python and SQL.
* Experience building reproducible analysis pipelines and automated reporting, ideally in Qualtrics and Databricks.
* Experience automating survey and analysis workflows using AI (Claude)
* Ability to translate analysis into concrete insight that a senior audience can act on, and to defend a methodological call when challenged.
* Experience collaborating with other marketing, data and analytics disciplines on combining disparate data sources.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: Database Architect
description:
Role Scope
  
  
Owns data architecture across multiple domains, with dual focus: (1) modernizing legacy database systems—particularly large-scale SQL Server environments with complex stored procedures containing embedded business logic, and (2) designing AI-native data infrastructure—semantic data models, vector databases, and RAG architectures that power AI agents and workflows. Establishes patterns for domain-driven data models, event-driven data flows, and canonical schemas across relational, NoSQL, analytical, and AI-optimized data platforms.
  
  
The Problem We're Solving
  
  
We have two interconnected data architecture challenges.
  
  
Legacy modernization: SQL Server stored procedures that have grown to thousands of lines, with business logic deeply embedded in T-SQL that should live in application services. These procedures are difficult to test, impossible to reuse, and create tight coupling between business rules and data access. They slow down development, complicate domain ownership, and resist modernization efforts.
  
  
AI data infrastructure: We're building AI agents and agentic workflows that require purpose-built data architecture—semantic models that capture domain knowledge, vector databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embedding pipelines, and knowledge graphs that give AI systems the context they need to operate effectively. This isn't about bolting AI onto existing data systems; it's about designing data infrastructure that makes AI-native applications possible.
  
  
These challenges intersect: the domain knowledge locked in legacy systems becomes training data and context for AI agents. The canonical models we build for modernization become the semantic foundation for AI retrieval. We need database architects who can work across both dimensions—modernizing legacy while building for an AI-native future.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Database Architect who combines deep expertise in legacy database systems with forward-looking vision for AI-native data architecture. You'll lead the decomposition of complex stored procedures while simultaneously designing the vector databases, embedding strategies, and semantic models that power our AI agents and workflows.
  
  
This is an AI-first role in two senses: you'll leverage AI to accelerate your own work (stored procedure analysis, migration generation, schema documentation), and you'll design the data infrastructure that AI systems depend on. If you're excited about both solving hard legacy database problems and architecting the data layer for AI-native applications, this role is for you.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Legacy Database Modernization
  
  

* Analyze and decompose large SQL Server stored procedures (1,000+ lines) with embedded business logic, creating migration strategies that extract logic into domain services
* Design patterns for separating business rules from data access, enabling stored procedures to become thin data-access layers while business logic moves to application services
* Lead refactoring efforts that align database structures with domain-driven design: bounded contexts, aggregates, and domain events
* Implement event-driven patterns that decouple systems from direct database dependencies: change data capture, outbox patterns, event sourcing where appropriate
* Optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and execution plans as part of modernization efforts
* Create migration playbooks and tooling that engineering teams can apply to their own stored procedure modernization

AI Data Infrastructure & Semantic Modeling
  
  

* Design semantic data models that capture domain knowledge in structures optimized for AI retrieval and reasoning
* Architect vector database solutions for RAG implementations: embedding strategies, chunking approaches, similarity search optimization, and hybrid retrieval patterns
* Design and implement embedding pipelines that transform domain content into vector representations suitable for AI agent consumption
* Establish knowledge graph patterns where appropriate: entity relationships, ontologies, and graph-based retrieval for complex domain reasoning
* Define data architectures for AI agent context: what data agents need, how it's structured, how freshness and consistency are maintained
* Design evaluation frameworks for RAG quality: retrieval accuracy, relevance scoring, and feedback loops for continuous improvement

Modern Data Platform Architecture
  
  

* Design canonical data models and schemas that are flexible, extensible, and aligned with business domain concepts
* Architect data solutions across multiple platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB/Cosmos DB, Snowflake, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search)
* Design event-driven data flows: Kafka-based event streaming, materialized views, CQRS patterns, and real-time data synchronization
* Establish data platform infrastructure patterns: data pipelines, ETL/ELT orchestration, data quality frameworks, and observability
* Define data residency, partitioning, and multi-region strategies for performance and compliance
* Create reference architectures for common data patterns that domain teams can adopt

AI-First Database Engineering
  
  

* Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate stored procedure analysis, refactoring, and migration
* Build AI-powered tools for database engineering: automated stored procedure analysis, schema documentation generators, migration assistants, and query optimization recommenders
* Create AI-consumable artifacts: structured documentation, annotated schemas, and context files that enable AI agents to understand and work with database systems
* Author database architecture skills that encode patterns, constraints, and best practices for AI-assisted development
* Develop prompts, workflows, and tooling that help engineering teams apply AI effectively to database modernization tasks

Cross-Domain Leadership
  
  

* Partner with AI/ML teams to ensure data architecture supports agent and workflow requirements
* Collaborate with domain teams to understand their data requirements and design solutions aligned with domain ownership
* Work with application architects to ensure data architecture supports service-oriented and event-driven designs
* Contribute to Enterprise Architecture Council (EAC) standards for data architecture, modeling conventions, and technology selection
* Mentor engineers on database design, optimization, semantic modeling, and AI data infrastructure

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 8–12 years in database engineering and architecture, with significant experience in enterprise-scale SQL Server environments
* Deep SQL Server expertise: T-SQL optimization, stored procedure design and refactoring, query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and performance tuning
* Hands-on modernization experience: track record of decomposing complex stored procedures and migrating business logic to application services
* Multi-platform data architecture: experience designing solutions across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB), and analytical (Snowflake, data lakehouse) platforms
* Event-driven data patterns: CDC, Kafka, outbox pattern, event sourcing, CQRS—practical experience implementing these in production
* Data modeling expertise: canonical models, dimensional modeling, schema evolution, and designing for extensibility

AI & Semantic Data Competencies
  
  

* Vector database experience: hands-on with at least one vector DB (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Azure AI Search, or similar)
* RAG architecture understanding: embedding models, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, hybrid search, and reranking patterns
* Semantic modeling: experience designing data structures optimized for AI retrieval—knowledge representation, ontologies, or domain-specific schemas for AI consumption
* Understanding of embedding pipelines: text preprocessing, embedding generation, vector indexing, and incremental updates
* Familiarity with LLM context requirements: what data AI agents need, token constraints, context window optimization

AI-Native Engineering Practices
  
  

* 2+ years actively using AI coding assistants for database work; deep understanding of how to prompt effectively for SQL and data engineering tasks
* Experience building tools, scripts, or automation that leverage AI/LLM capabilities
* Familiarity with structured artifact creation for AI consumption: documented schemas, annotated procedures, context files
* Vision for AI-assisted database engineering and ability to build tooling that enables it

Technical Depth
  
  

* Strong programming skills in at least one backend language (C#, Java, Python) for building migration tooling, embedding pipelines, and services
* Cloud data services experience: Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or AWS equivalents
* Infrastructure-as-code for data platforms: Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation
* Understanding of domain-driven design and how data architecture supports bounded contexts
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS)

**Preferred Experience**

* Background in healthcare, benefits, payments, or similarly regulated industries
* Experience building RAG systems or AI-powered search/retrieval applications
* Knowledge graph experience: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar graph databases
* Contributions to database tooling, AI/ML data infrastructure, or open-source projects
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading database/data architecture communities of practice

What Success Looks Like
  
  
In 90 days: Completed assessment of priority stored procedure modernization targets and AI data infrastructure needs; delivered first AI-assisted analysis tooling; established vector database patterns for initial RAG implementations
  
  
In 6 months: Led decomposition of at least one major stored procedure system; semantic data models and RAG architecture patterns established and being adopted; AI-powered database engineering tools in active use by teams
  
  
In 12 months: Measurable reduction in stored procedure complexity across priority systems; AI data infrastructure supporting production agent workflows; recognized as the go-to expert for both database modernization and AI-native data architecture
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Data architecture is being transformed from two directions simultaneously.
  
  
From the legacy side: business logic buried in stored procedures creates invisible dependencies that resist refactoring. Traditional approaches to database modernization are slow, manual, and error-prone—but AI can analyze thousands of lines of T-SQL, identify patterns, and accelerate migrations in ways that weren't possible before.
  
  
From the AI side: agents and workflows need purpose-built data infrastructure. The semantic models, vector databases, and knowledge representations you design will determine how effectively AI can reason about our domains. This isn't a nice-to-have capability; it's foundational to our AI-native engineering strategy.
  
  
You'll work at the intersection of these transformations—solving hard legacy problems while building the data infrastructure that makes AI-native applications possible. The patterns you establish will shape how we approach data architecture across the enterprise.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
**Who are we?**

A world where complexity is the only constant demands a new breed of company. Brave Bison is a different beast: a media, marketing and technology company purpose built for the digital era.

Our universe is made up of award-winning business arms Brave Bison, Engage, SocialChain and MTM. And we’re underpinned by leading marketing training practice, MiniMBA, as well as our very own social-first media network who deliver monthly views in the billions for some of the biggest channels in sport and entertainment across YouTube, Snap, Meta and TikTok.

We’re a global collective who live and breathe digital, working with some of the boldest brands in the world to capitalise on the complexity that defines the modern marketing landscape.

**Our mission**

New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations—our clients’ worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn’t. It’s our job to cut through the chaos, make the complex simple and navigate a clear path to growth for them.

That’s why we make it our mission to
**capitalise on complexity**
for our clients—across consultancy, capability and execution—by crafting dynamic digital solutions that outpace tomorrow’s challenges.

**Our values**

We’re a proudly diverse business comprised of deep specialists across social media, digital marketing and technology. Although our skills, backgrounds and beliefs may differ, we are united by four core shared values:

* **Bold Curiosity.**

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

* **Connected Clarity.**

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

* **Positive Encouragement.**

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

* **Constant Impact.**

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive and hands-on Senior Systems Administrator to join our global IT team.

You will play a key role in managing, securing and improving our technology environment across Microsoft 365, cloud infrastructure, Windows and macOS devices, networking and security platforms.

Working closely with the IT Manager and wider IT team, you will take ownership of technical initiatives, resolve complex infrastructure issues and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, security and automation.

As a growing business with multiple international offices, we are looking for someone who can adapt to changing priorities, work independently and take responsibility for delivering high-quality technical solutions.

Whilst this is not a people management position, you will provide technical guidance, mentoring and escalation support to other members of the IT team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Microsoft 365, Identity and Endpoints**

* Administer and optimise Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including licensing, access controls and Conditional Access policies.
* Manage Windows and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune and other MDM platforms, including policies, updates, patching and health monitoring.

**Infrastructure, Networking and Security**

* Administer cloud and server infrastructure (virtual machines, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP), support firewalls, VPNs and wireless, and maintain backups with regular recovery tests.
* Work closely with the Information & Cyber Security Manager to implement technical security controls, remediate vulnerabilities, support incident investigations and provide evidence for audits.
* Set up, configure and troubleshoot networking equipment such as switches, firewalls and wireless access points.

**Automation and Day-to-Day Operations**

* Share the day-to-day IT support workload with the wider team, including user queries, hardware, software and network issues, and onboarding and offboarding requests.
* Develop PowerShell scripts and use APIs and automation tools to cut manual work, including onboarding and offboarding, and recommend improvements to systems and processes.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, finding root causes, taking incidents through to resolution and keeping documentation accurate.

**Projects and Migrations**

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects from planning to implementation, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Google Workspace migrations and the integration of newly acquired businesses.
* Give clear progress updates, highlighting risks, blockers and decisions needed.

**Collaboration**

* Mentor junior team members, share knowledge and work with colleagues across countries and business units.
* Take part in planned maintenance and agreed out-of-hours support.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* At least six years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune, and strong Windows administration with experience supporting macOS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and networking fundamentals.
* Practical PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Experience supporting users with day-to-day IT issues.
* Experience with endpoint security, patch management, backup and disaster recovery.
* Able to independently resolve complex technical issues and deliver technical projects.
* Strong written and spoken English.

**Desirable Experience and Skills**

* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Kandji, Freshservice, Microsoft Graph or REST API integrations, Meraki or Fortinet.
* Google Workspace migrations, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, and experience supporting mergers and acquisitions.
* Relevant Microsoft, networking or cloud certifications.

**Personal Attributes**

* A team player who shares knowledge, asks for help early and supports colleagues.
* Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Proactive, takes ownership and makes technical recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and able to prioritise.

Master's Degree

* Cloud Application Architecture: Exposure to cloud application architecture, including performing initial analysis on incidents and identifying potential issues.

title: Security Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Security Consultant**
**Job Summary:**
As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.
  
  
The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  
**Client Technology (CT) -**
focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –**
EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
**Information Security (Info Sec) -**
Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity:**
The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.
  
  
The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**
This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.
  
  

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

**Skills and attributes for success:**
The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.
  
  
A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

**What working at EY offers:**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Product Compliance Engineer – Genset Compliance Management**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**Product Compliance Engineer**
to lead product safety and compliance management activities for generator set (Genset) products across countries in Rest of World (RoW - Europe, Middle-East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Australia-NZ and Latin America other than United States and Canada). This role is responsible for ensuring products meet all applicable regulatory, safety, and industry certification requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between the engineering organization and certification agencies in respective regions that could include UL, CSA, and other recognized certification and regulatory bodies, ensuring timely certification, maintenance of approvals, and resolution of compliance-related issues. The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Quality, and external agencies to support product development, certification, and market access objectives.
  
  
This position also requires periodic travel to test laboratories and certification facilities to witness product testing, support certification activities, and ensure compliance requirements are met. In addition, the role will be responsible for establishing and continuously improving compliance management processes and governance frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance Management**

* Manage regulatory and compliance requirements for generator set products marketed in countries other than the United States and Canada.
* Knowledgeable in applicable standards, codes, and regulations relevant to gensets and associated electrical systems.
* Ensure products maintain compliance including new product development, product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
* Monitor evolving regulatory and certification requirements and assess impact on products and business operations.

**Certification & Agency Management**

* Serve as the primary technical contact for certification agencies,

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Regulatory & Certification requirements covering the Machinery, EMC, RoHS & Noise Directives
+ Other certification, testing, and regulatory organizations as required

* Coordinate certification projects, audits, inspections, and follow-up activities.
* Manage certification documentation, test reports, technical files, and approval records.
* Drive timely closure of certification findings, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.

**Engineering Support**

* Provide compliance guidance to product development and engineering teams during design and development phases.
* Review product designs, drawings, specifications, and change requests for compliance impacts.
* Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to compliance issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into product designs.

**Regulatory Support & Consultation**

* Respond to compliance and regulatory inquiries from:

+ Engineering teams
+ Sales and commercial teams
+ Operations and manufacturing teams
+ Quality and service organizations

* Provide technical guidance on the application of standards and certification requirements.
* Support customer and regulatory compliance documentation requests.

**Testing & Validation**

* Coordinate compliance testing activities with internal teams and external laboratories.
* Develop test plans and compliance validation strategies.
* Travel to certification laboratories and test facilities to witness testing and represent the company during certification evaluations.
* Review and approve testing documentation and certification evidence.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance management processes, procedures, and governance models.
* Establish compliance metrics, reporting mechanisms, and tracking tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve compliance efficiency, reduce certification lead times, and improve product readiness.
* Support compliance training and awareness programs across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Generation, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred but not required.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in product compliance, certification, regulatory engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience with generator sets, power generation equipment, industrial electrical products, or similar engineered products preferred.
* Strong experience working with certification agencies and notified bodies for EU Regulatory certification. Working knowledge on RoHS, Outdoor Noise and other related EU Directives.
* Experience managing third-party testing and certification projects.
* Experience interpreting and applying Global product safety and compliance standards.

**Technical Skills (Top Skills Required)**
**Regulatory & Compliance Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of RoW product compliance requirements for electrical and power generation equipment.
* Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Certification Management**

* Experience coordinating certifications with:

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Notified Bodies
+ Africa & Middle-East regulatory agencies
+ Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTLs)
+ Certification and inspection bodies

**Product Safety Standards**

* Knowledge of applicable standards and codes, including:

+ UL standards
+ CSA standards
+ Electrical safety requirements
+ Applicable NFPA and industry requirements
+ Generator set and power system compliance requirements
+ All related ISO / IEC / EN Standards

**Product Development Support**

* Design review and compliance assessment capability.
* Engineering change impact assessment from a regulatory perspective.
* Risk assessment and compliance validation planning.

**Testing & Validation**

* Product certification testing coordination.
* Test plan development and execution.
* Test witnessing and compliance verification.

**Documentation & Compliance Systems**

* Technical documentation management.
* Certification file maintenance.
* Compliance records and audit preparation.
* Process development and governance documentation.

**Project Management**

* Managing multiple certification and compliance projects simultaneously.
* Planning, tracking, and reporting compliance activities.
* Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.

**Soft Skills**
**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities.

**Relationship Management**

* Ability to build effective working relationships with certification agencies, regulatory bodies, laboratories, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong customer-focused mindset when supporting internal and external compliance inquiries.

**Analytical Thinking**

* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to evaluate technical data and make sound compliance-related decisions.

**Attention to Detail**

* High level of accuracy in reviewing standards, certifications, test reports, and compliance documentation.
* Strong focus on quality and risk mitigation.

**Leadership & Influence**

* Ability to influence engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Drive compliance requirements effectively across cross-functional organizations.

**Adaptability**

* Ability to manage changing regulatory requirements and evolving business priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic product development environment.

**Collaboration**

* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and Sales organizations.

**Initiative & Ownership**

* Self-motivated with strong ownership of compliance deliverables.
* Ability to independently drive certification and compliance activities to successful completion.

**Travel Requirements**

* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Travel to certification laboratories, customer locations, manufacturing sites, and testing facilities to support compliance testing, certification activities, regulatory audits, and technical reviews.
* Estimated travel: 5-10%, depending on project and certification needs.

**Success Measures**
**The Product Compliance Engineer Will Be Successful When**

* Products achieve and maintain required certifications for countries in the regions other than US and Canadian markets.
* Compliance risks are proactively identified and mitigated.
* Certification projects are completed on schedule.
* Internal compliance inquiries are addressed accurately and promptly.
* Effective compliance processes and governance mechanisms are established and sustained.
* Strong working relationships are maintained with certification agencies and regulatory stakeholders.

: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.

October 26, 2026 - October 30, 2026
